description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I: Bartz - Fire] and [Spellblade Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I: Bartz - Fire
description.text: Spellblade abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x1.50/x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Spellblade abilities after casting 1/2/3/4+ Spellblade abilities, casts Dual Spellblade Firedance after using Spellblade abilities (max 3)

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II: Bartz - Fire], removes [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I: Bartz - Fire]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II: Bartz - Fire
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Spellblade abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 1 additional time, grants [Spellblade +10% Boost 1]/[Spellblade +30% Boost 1]/[Spellblade +50% Boost 1] to the user after using 1/2/3+ Spellblade abilities

description.name: Dual Spellblade Firedance
description.text: Six single attacks (0.64 each), 0.71 if exploiting Fire weakness

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3
